positive_terms: Total amount of substances of very high concern that are generated or used during production or that are procured by main hazard classes of substances of concern
生产生成使用或采购的高度关注物质量
substances of very high concern input

Total amount of substances of very high concern that are generated or used during production or that are procured by main hazard classes of substances of concern。生产生成使用或采购的高度关注物质量。以物质或危害类别、关注/高度关注分类、生成/使用/采购或离开设施流向、期间与设施范围区分。分类不是同义词，重叠输入不能盲目求和；总量与明细不可重复计数。
